summary: Short, steep, treed lane end with no stopping signs and homes close by.

best_section.where: Union Street lane end, east side, by the bend

drivers.seclusion: Dense tree cover, but dwellings 13 m and 17 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane under canopy; no clear pull-off beside the lane. Section is shorter than a van.
drivers.convention: Three No Stopping Any Time signs on the stretch; no parked cars seen.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the section, mostly shaded.
